SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT NVL(SYS160.SYS160_CMPS,' ') AS PLANT , PODT.PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO FROM ICOYPOHD POHD, ICOYPODT PODT, ICOYCNDT CNDT, COM.SYS170TL SYS170, COM.SYS160TL SYS160 WHERE POHD.VENDOR_CODE = 'VC1290' AND POHD.IF_PO_FLAG = 'N' AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.EXEC_NO = CNDT.EXEC_NO AND PODT.EXEC_SEQ= CNDT.EXEC_SEQ AND CNDT.ROOM_CD = SYS170.SYS170_ROOM_CD AND SYS170.SYS170_BLD_CD = SYS160.SYS160_BLD_CD GROUP BY SYS160.SYS160_CMPS, PODT.PO_NO ORDER BY SYS160.SYS160_CMPS, PODT.PO_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'DONGA' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , NVL(SYS160.SYS160_CMPS,' ') AS PLANT , PODT.PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO , PODT.PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , 'C' AS STATUS , PODT.ITEM_CODE AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE , PODT.EST_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , PODT.REQ_QUTY AS ITEM_QTY , PODT.EST_AMT AS ITEM_AMT , POHD.PO_DATE AS ADD_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE+3,'YYYYMMDD') AS RD_DATE , SYS170.SYS170_ROOM_CD AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , POHD.ADD_USER_ID AS PURCHASER_USER_ID , UINFO.USERNAME || '/' || UINFO.DEPTNAME || '/' || UINFO.USERTEL AS REQ_USER_INFO , PODT.EXEC_NO||'-'||PODT.EXEC_SEQ AS LEGACY_PR_NO , DECODE(SYS160_CMPS,'01','승학', '02','구덕', '03','부민',SYS160_CMPS) ||'^'|| SYS160.SYS160_BLD_NM ||'^'|| SYS170.SYS170_ROOM_NM ||'^'|| PODT.DT_DESC AS REMARK FROM ICOYPOHD POHD , ICOYPODT PODT , ICOYCNDT CNDT , COM.SYS170TL SYS170 , COM.SYS160TL SYS160 , ADM.USERINFOVW UINFO WHERE POHD.VENDOR_CODE = 'VC1290' AND POHD.IF_PO_FLAG = 'N' AND POHD.PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.EXEC_NO = CNDT.EXEC_NO AND PODT.EXEC_SEQ= CNDT.EXEC_SEQ AND CNDT.ROOM_CD = SYS170.SYS170_ROOM_CD AND SYS170.SYS170_BLD_CD = SYS160.SYS160_BLD_CD AND POHD.ADD_USER_ID = UINFO.USERID
UPDATE ICOYPOHD SET IF_PO_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$'
